def card(p):
    """Format profile dict as a plain-text terminal card."""
    lines = []

    lines.append(f"Length: {p['length']}")
    lines.append(f"Variety: {p['variety']}")

    top_words_str = ', '.join(f"{word} ({count})" for word, count in p['top_words'])
    lines.append(f"Top words: {top_words_str}")

    return '\n'.join(lines)
